The text "Android XR" is prominently displayed in the center in bold, black font. Surrounding the text are several smaller images that represent various activities and settings: Top Left: A group of people smiling and posing together, suggesting social interaction or a fun gathering. Top Center: A person holding a smartphone, indicating the use of mobile devices.
